title: OccSora: 4D Occupancy Generation Models as World Simulators for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: 4D occupancy sequences (16 s videos of 3D semantic occupancy)

control_signal.value: ego car trajectory prompt, for example go straight, turning right, motionless

control_mechanism.value: trajectory labels and denoising timestep fed as supplementary inputs alongside token embeddings into the diffusion transformer blocks

base_model.value: 4D occupancy scene tokenizer (3D conv encoder, VQ codebook, decoder) plus a diffusion transformer over the discrete spatial-temporal tokens

datasets.value: nuScenes with Occ3D occupancy annotations; clips of 32 consecutive frames

metrics.value: reconstruction IoU and mIoU; generation FID

controllability_evidence.value: Ablation: removing trajectory conditioning raises FID from 8.34 to 17.48. Per-trajectory FID is 8.902 go straight, 10.886 turning right, 5.257 motionless.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop trajectory-conditioned generation of 16 s clips. Closed-loop end-to-end driving is listed as future work.

stated_limitations.value: Voxel granularity prevents finer 4D scenes; moving-object details are inconsistent, possibly due to small training data.

notes: Table 3 labels rows only by check marks; I matched the 17.48 row to the missing trajectory column.
